WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    ili.product_quantity,
    (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost AS cost_diff_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS FLOAT)) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(cost_diff_ratio) AS avg_cost_diff_ratio
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY order_item_id, product_color
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_diff_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC) AS rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_diff_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
